race.comment: AISLE TWO (3) above average mare who graduated quickly to Group company last time in. Slashing return along the inside when third over 1300m at Randwick in Bm72 class. Ready for this trip and further now and can get over the top of these with the claim. GLISSANDO (5) given plenty of time to develop and starting to reap the rewards. Ran her rivals ragged to get the Maiden win out of the way by a big space at Kembla two-back. Sent to town with a similar performance as fav demolishing a small field over 1550m at Canterbury. Can take control from the wide draw and go close. TRANSCEND (4) back marker who raced without luck last prep. Returned with a fast-finishing fourth over 1300m at Randwick Kensington with the 58.5kg. Proven second up and stays in the mix. PIERATA'S GEM (7) gets in light again after finishing third over this track and trip last start. Place best. ISHIKARI (9) won over this trip last prep in Highway class. Sits on the speed and has each way prospects.
